1.bug_scenario: The bug report describes an issue with the rendering of offset and rotated text in vector layers and vector contexts. Specifically, the vector layer renderer rotates offset text around the feature from which it is offset, while the immediate renderer rotates it around its offset anchor point. This inconsistency becomes apparent when both offset and rotation are applied together, leading to different behaviors between vector layer and immediate renderers.
